title: Send the quarterly investor report
summary: Report performance, cash, leasing and capital spending to investors on a fixed schedule.
outlineSteps: Close the quarter's books and the rent roll
Report occupancy, leasing and tenant credit
Report remaining lease term and the rollover ahead
Report NOI and cash against budget
Show cash rent apart from straight-line rent
Show leasing costs and capital spending against plan
Report loan coverage and covenant headroom
Report distributions paid and cash held
Write a plain account of what changed and why
Check the report's figures before release
Send the report and file a copy
